items.headline: Four TDs in Week 6 win
items.text: Shough completed 16 of 30 passes for 144 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 34-27 win over the Giants. He added 32 yards and a TD on five carries.

items.headline: Workload shrinks in Dowdle's return
items.text: Warren carried the ball 14 times for 50 yards and caught two of four targets for 28 yards in Sunday's 26-19 overtime win over the Buccaneers.

items.headline: Two touchdowns in Week 6 win
items.text: McCaffrey rushed 16 times for 64 yards and two touchdowns and brought in nine of 10 targets for 53 yards in the 49ers' 23-17 win over the Commanders on Monday night. He also lost a fumble.

items.headline: Full practice Friday
items.text: Pickens (shoulder) was a full participant in Friday's practice, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

items.headline: Modest production on 10 targets
items.text: London brought in four of 10 targets for 62 yards in the Falcons' 31-23 loss to the Bears on Sunday. He also recorded a two-point conversion catch.

items.headline: Good to go for Week 7
items.text: Kelce (ankle) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.

items.headline: Minimal role in Week 7 loss
items.text: Henderson rushed three times for nine yards and secured both targets for 14 yards in the Patriots' 30-24 loss to the Bears on Thursday.

items.headline: Another lackluster showing in Week 6 loss
items.text: Godwin caught four of eight targets for 37 yards in Sunday's 26-19 overtime loss to the Steelers.

items.headline: Strong fantasy night in loss
items.text: Daniels completed 29 of 40 passes for 300 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while adding four rushes for 10 yards in the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday night.

items.headline: Scores TD in return from injury
items.text: Diggs brought in six of seven targets for 44 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday night.

items.headline: Five catches in loss
items.text: Strange caught five of seven targets for 44 yards during Sunday's 34-31 loss to the Texans.

items.headline: Nine touches in Week 6 win
items.text: Black rushed eight times for 34 yards and brought in his only target for three yards in the 49ers' 23-17 win over the Commanders on Monday night.

items.headline: Activated from injured reserve
items.text: Dell (knee) was activated from injured reserve Saturday, and his questionable designation has been removed for Sunday's game against the Giants.

items.headline: Beats Rams despite dearth of TDs
items.text: Brissett completed 24 of 35 passes for 218 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 18-16 win over the Rams. He also rushed twice for two yards.

items.headline: Leading rusher in Week 6 win
items.text: Miller carried the ball 20 times for 70 yards and caught both his targets for zero yards in Sunday's 34-27 win over the Giants.

items.headline: Cleared from injury report
items.text: Kamara (back) was limited at Friday's practice but does not have an injury designation for Week 7, Katherine Terrell of ESPN.com reports.

items.headline: Catches game-winning TD in Week 6
items.text: Bernard caught 11 of 12 targets for 87 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-19 overtime win over the Bucs.

items.headline: One-handed TD in win
items.text: Chase brought in six of 10 targets for 77 yards and a touchdown in the Bengals' 31-24 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.

items.headline: Week 7 role uncertain
items.text: Allen's workload and role Sunday against Miami is unclear given that Breece Hall (quadriceps) is officially questionable to play, per Amanda Vogt of the Jets' official site .

items.headline: Leads comeback in OT win
items.text: Rodgers completed 33 of 49 passes for 253 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 26-19 overtime win over the Buccaneers.

items.headline: Tallies five catches in Week 6 victory
items.text: Bourne caught five of eight targets for 47 yards during the Cardinals' 18-16 win over the Rams on Sunday.

items.headline: Two more scoring grabs in loss
items.text: Pitts brought in five of seven targets for 60 yards and two touchdowns in the Falcons' 31-23 loss to the Bears on Sunday.

items.headline: Sparsely used offensively in Week 6 loss
items.text: Mitchell turned two carries into four yards, failed to haul in his lone target and returned four kickoffs for 87 yards during Sunday's 22-6 loss to the Chiefs.

items.headline: Officially ruled out
items.text: Montgomery (groin) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Giants, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

items.headline: Reaches end zone in victory
items.text: Perine rushed 14 times for 68 yards while catching both of his targets for 10 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 31-24 win over Miami.

items.headline: Cleared for Week 7
items.text: Waddle (chest) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game at Arizona.

items.headline: Clear for Week 7
items.text: Hockenson (concussion) practiced fully Friday and doesn't have a designation for Sunday's game versus the Colts, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

items.headline: Four grabs in Week 6 loss
items.text: Downs caught four of eight targets for 40 yards in Sunday's 26-20 loss to the Titans. He added seven rushing yards on his only carry.

items.headline: Catches three passes in Week 6 win
items.text: Vele caught three of six targets for 42 yards during the Saints' 34-27 win over the Giants on Sunday.

items.headline: Logs 16 touches in lead role
items.text: Pierce rushed 12 times for 35 yards and a touchdown and brought in four of five targets for 15 yards in the Eagles' 25-14 loss to the Panthers on Sunday.

items.headline: Held to one catch Sunday
items.text: Fannin brought in one of three targets for nine yards in the Browns' 13-10 win over the Ravens on Sunday.

items.headline: Receiving TD with expanded role
items.text: White rushed seven times for 27 yards and brought in four of five targets for 30 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday night.

items.headline: Officially placed on IR
items.text: The Steelers placed Pittman (foot) on injured reserve Saturday.

items.headline: Tosses three TDs in big divisional win
items.text: Stroud completed 24 of 34 passes for 312 yards and three touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 34-31 win over the Jaguars. He added five yards on his only carry.

items.headline: Efficient with limited opportunity
items.text: Robinson rushed nine times for 61 yards and brought in both targets for minus-8 yards in the Falcons' 31-23 loss to the Bears on Sunday.

items.headline: Grinds out yards, TD in win
items.text: Swift rushed 22 times for 78 yards and a touchdown and brought in all four targets for 12 yards in the Bears' 30-24 win over the Patriots on Thursday.

items.headline: Six catches in Week 6 loss
items.text: Flowers brought in six of 11 targets for 66 yards and rushed once for one yard in the Ravens' 13-10 loss to the Browns on Sunday.

items.headline: Logs full practice Thursday
items.text: Jefferson (ankle) practiced in full Thursday, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

items.headline: Five more catches in Week 6 win
items.text: Kraft caught five of eight targets for 37 yards in Sunday night's 23-13 win over the Cowboys.

items.headline: Four total TDs in win
items.text: Goff completed 19 of 30 passes for 271 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions while adding a one-yard touchdown on his only rush attempt in the Lions' 45-21 win over the Cardinals on Sunday. He also committed a fumble recovered by Detroit.

items.headline: Solid performance as lead back
items.text: Gordon rushed 18 times for 88 yards and a touchdown in the Dolphins' 31-24 loss to the Bengals on Sunday.

items.headline: Late TD not enough in Week 6 loss
items.text: Prescott completed 34 of 54 passes for 258 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions in Sunday's 23-13 loss to the Packers. He also rushed twice for seven yards.

items.headline: Held to two catches in win
items.text: Robinson caught three of seven targets for 22 yards during Sunday's 26-20 win over the Colts.

items.headline: Three catches in Houston debut
items.text: Harrison caught three of four targets for 34 yards in Sunday's 34-31 win over the Jaguars.

items.headline: May be close to practicing
items.text: Conner (foot) is close to practicing, but the Cardinals aren't expected to open his 21-day evaluation window this week, John Gambadoro of Arizona Sports 98.7 FM reports.

items.headline: Another efficient effort in win
items.text: Purdy completed 21 of 29 passes for 264 yards with one touchdown and no interceptions while adding five rushes for 28 yards in the 49ers' 23-17 win over the Commanders on Monday night.

items.headline: Solid production with nine touches
items.text: Harvey rushed six times for 25 yards and a touchdown and brought in three of four targets for 31 yards in the Broncos' 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday.

items.headline: Questionable for Week 7
items.text: Barkley (hamstring) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Cowboys.

items.headline: Finds end zone in Week 6 win
items.text: Olave caught four of seven targets for 43 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 34-27 win over the Giants.

items.headline: Leads air attack in lopsided victory
items.text: LaPorta brought in all five of his targets for 88 yards and a touchdown in the Lions' 45-21 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.

items.headline: KC's top wideout for Week 7
items.text: Worthy will once again operate as the Chiefs' top wide receiver after Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) was ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Seahawks, Pete Sweeney of The Kansas City Star reports.

items.headline: Cleared for return in Week 7
items.text: Judkins (ankle) doesn't have an injury designation and said he's "good to go" for Sunday's game against the Titans, Mary Kay Cabot of the Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

items.headline: Leading rusher in first win of year
items.text: Pollard carried the ball 19 times for 76 yards and failed to catch his only target in Sunday's 26-20 win over the Colts.

items.headline: Season-best effort in win
items.text: Burden brought in all four targets for 130 yards and a touchdown and rushed once for seven yards in the Bears' 30-24 win over the Patriots on Thursday.

items.headline: Sees season-low snap share in win
items.text: Boutte finished with two receptions for 16 yards on three targets in Sunday's 34-31 win over the Jaguars in London.

items.headline: Posts 5-97-2 line in Week 6 defeat
items.text: Tucker caught five of seven targets for 97 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 33-30 loss to the Bills.

items.headline: Quiet in Week 6 win
items.text: Waller failed to catch either of his two targets in Sunday's 25-14 win over the Eagles.

items.headline: Compiles 134 all-purpose yards in loss
items.text: Washington secured six of eight targets for 43 yards, rushed once for 18 yards, returned two kickoffs for 45 yards and ran back one punt for 28 yards in the Dolphins' 31-24 loss to the Bengals on Sunday.

items.headline: Highly efficient in close loss
items.text: Maye completed 24 of 31 passes for 321 yards with two touchdowns and one interception while adding four rushes for 26 yards and another score in the Patriots' 30-24 loss to the Bears on Thursday.

items.headline: Practices fully Thursday
items.text: Love (back) was a full practice participant Thursday, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.

items.headline: Scores again in Week 6 defeat
items.text: Williams rushed 11 times for 41 yards and a touchdown while catching both of his targets for nine yards in Sunday's 23-13 loss to the Packers.

items.headline: Expected to play Sunday
items.text: Jacobs had his roster exemption removed by the Packers and is expected to play Sunday at Detroit, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

items.headline: Massive numbers after slow start
items.text: Smith-Njigba brought in 12 of 16 targets for 134 yards in the Seahawks' 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos on Thursday.

items.headline: Set to play Sunday
items.text: Golden (shoulder) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Lions.

items.headline: Another big day in Week 6 loss
items.text: Likely caught six of 11 targets for 99 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 34-27 loss to the Saints.

items.headline: Grinds out yards, TD in OT win
items.text: Dobbins rushed 17 times for 41 yards and a touchdown and brought in all three targets for five yards during the Broncos' 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday.

items.headline: Solid production with six catches
items.text: McMillan secured six of nine targets for 86 yards in the Panthers' 25-14 win over the Eagles on Sunday.

items.headline: Sharpest game of season in win
items.text: Murray completed 24 of 30 passes for 229 yards with a touchdown and no interceptions while adding 10 rushes for 51 yards in the Vikings' 23-13 win over the Saints on Sunday. He also recovered a fumble.

items.headline: Eclipses 200 scrimmage yards in win
items.text: Gibbs rushed 25 times for 151 yards and two touchdowns while bringing in five of six targets for 56 yards in the Lions' 45-21 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.

items.headline: Held to three grabs in Week 6 win
items.text: Collins caught three of five targets for 74 yards in Sunday's 34-31 win over the Jaguars. He added five yards on his only carry.

items.headline: Impressive in return from injury
items.text: Coker brought in six of 13 targets for 97 yards in the Panthers' 25-14 win over the Eagles on Sunday. He also committed a fumble recovered by Carolina.

items.headline: Two catches in Week 5 win
items.text: Higgins brought in two of four targets for 22 yards in the Bengals' 31-24 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.

items.headline: Paces passing game in upset win
items.text: McBride caught seven of nine targets for 53 yards in Sunday's 18-16 win over the Rams.

items.headline: Catchless in Week 6
items.text: Johnson failed to reel in either of his targets during Sunday's 34-27 win over the Giants.

items.headline: Impressive numbers in Week 6 loss
items.text: Cousins completed 23 of 41 passes for 313 yards with two touchdowns and one interception in the Raiders' 33-30 loss to the Bills on Sunday.
